Panic/crash recovery middleware. Catches unhandled exceptions and returns 500 instead of crashing.Returns the default PanicRecoveryOptions: JSON error format, stderr logging enabled, no stack traces, no report hook.Builds a panic-recovery middleware from the given PanicRecoveryOptions.Builds a panic-recovery middleware with default options plus the given reportHook.

Types

ErrorReportHook = proc (err: ref Exception; req: Req; path: string) {.closure.}
Invoked when an exception is caught. path is the raw decoded request path (unsanitized) and may contain control characters; sanitize it before writing to structured logging systems.

proc panicRecovery(options: PanicRecoveryOptions = defaultPanicRecoveryOptions()): AsyncMiddleware {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Creates an async middleware that catches unhandled exceptions from downstream handlers and returns a generic 500 response instead of crashing the process.
  • CatchableError: logged when options.logErrors is true; the stack trace is logged only when options.includeStackTrace is true.
  • Defect: message and stack trace are always logged (when options.logErrors is true), regardless of options.includeStackTrace.
  • When options.reportHook is set, it is invoked with the raw exception, the request, and the raw (unsanitized) decoded path.
proc panicRecovery(reportHook: ErrorReportHook): AsyncMiddleware {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Creates a panic-recovery middleware with default options plus the given reportHook. See panicRecovery(options) for behavior.
